summary: Grade 2 roles near Eltham are thin but not empty, and most are in public or Mental Health and Wellbeing Local services. Several are fixed-term or casual, and none of the closing dates could be confirmed, so check each employer's site first.
criteria: Grade 2 roles within 25 km of Eltham VIC 3095
profile: Endorsed Clinical Psychologist (general registration + clinical endorsement), MPsych (Clinical)
15+ years: community mental health, acute inpatient, complex care
2.5 years as Senior Practice Leader supervising staff
Clinical Psychologist, private multidisciplinary allied health (since 2023)
Risk assessment, complex formulation, individual and group therapy, MDT work, GP and NDIS documentation, supervision
CBT, ACT, Motivational Interviewing, mindfulness-based, trauma-informed practice
Anxiety, depression, OCD, emotional dysregulation, trauma, severe and persistent mental illness, chronic and complex health
Eltham; north and north-east are easy commutes, west and south-east are long

jobs.title: Clinical Psychologist Grade 2, Mental Health and Wellbeing Local
jobs.why: Supports adults 26+ with mental health concerns, including co-occurring substance use. Fits her community mental health background and is permanent. The page is dated 25 July 2026, so it may have closed.

jobs.title: Community Mental Health Clinician, Merri-bek (Moreland) Community Team
jobs.grade: Grade 2 (OT, Social Worker or Psychologist); Grade 3 for Registered Psychiatric Nurse
jobs.source: CPCA job board (copy); also listed on SEEK and Jora
jobs.why: Medium to long-term specialist mental health support with assessment, interventions and care coordination. Closely matches her severe and persistent mental illness and community experience. It is a generic clinician role, not psychology-specific, and the employer's own ad wasn't reached.

jobs.title: Grade 2 Psychologist, Towards Change Team (parental leave, max-term)
jobs.work_type: Max-term part-time (3 days/week), 17 Sep 2026 to 17 Sep 2027
jobs.source: Access Health and Community careers (EthicalJobs copy dated 16 July 2026)
jobs.why: Trauma-informed care, ACT, DBT and mindfulness match her approaches. It is fixed-term and part-time, and the start date has passed, so it may be filled. The employer says it is assessing applications as they arrive.

jobs.title: Psychologist Grade 2 (P2), Thomas Embling Hospital
jobs.pay: $94,478.80 to $106,906.80 plus super and salary packaging
jobs.why: Duties suit her risk assessment and complex formulation strengths. The ad seeks forensic mental health experience, which she lacks, and it may be an older version. Forensicare's own careers page wasn't reached.

jobs.title: Grade 2 Clinical Psychologist (casual), psychosocial oncology
jobs.pay: $47.81 to $54.10 per hour (from a 2025 ad, probably out of date)
jobs.why: Draws on her chronic and complex health experience. It is casual, and psycho-oncology is a specialty she hasn't done.

jobs.title: Casual Grade 2 Psychologist (hospital medical and mental health services)
jobs.why: A lead only: the listing couldn't be dated and the employer ad wasn't found. Check thermh.org.au. It covers medical and mental health services, which fit her experience.

jobs.title: Grade 2 Psychologist, chronic pain
jobs.why: The ad was undated and few details were found. Chronic pain suits her chronic and complex health experience. Check the employer directly.

jobs.title: Clinical Psychologist Grade 2, Psychological Trauma Recovery Outpatient Service
jobs.work_type: Fixed-term, full-time (part-time considered); hybrid onsite/remote possible
jobs.why: Trauma treatment suits her and the site is close to home. It is fixed-term and may no longer be current. It includes a veterans group program and a Massed Prolonged Exposure pilot, a niche she hasn't listed.
